description: Get an overview of the stored memory: total count, episodes vs consolidated prototypes, number of learned associations, the list of domains, and average quality scores. This memory is shared across all AI tools the user has connected to Mnemoverse. Use it to orient yourself, to confirm the exact domain name before writing to it, or when the user asks what you remember. Read-only — changes nothing.
name: memory_stats

avg_importance.description: Average importance of stored memories, on a scale from 0 to 1.

avg_valence.description: Average valence of stored memories: how well recalls turned out, on a scale from -1 to 1.

episodes.description: Number of episodic (not yet consolidated) memories.

hebbian_edges.description: Number of Hebbian concept-to-concept links, learned from concepts that occur together as memories are stored and used.
